text:
maria_support: FYI customer (Acme, org 3556) reports ~30% 503s + high p95. They say traffic is landing in eu-central even though account is pinned to us-east. Sample curl + headers below.

dan_oncall: can you paste the exact curl and the response headers they see?

maria_support: sure — customer pasted this: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "x-redwood-region: us-east" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
They also see response header: `x-serving-region: eu-central` and latency ~700ms for those requests.

alyssa_infra: looking at gateway logs — spike at 2024-10-02T12:02Z. Route decision trace shows the `x-redwood-region` hint is being dropped at L7 filter chain for host `api.redwood.example.com`. That matches a config change from last deploy.

infra-bot: deploy-notify: listener-config v2 applied at 2024-10-02T11:59:50Z by kevin_runtime.

kevin_runtime: I pushed a tiny filter tweak to set `x-serving-region` on responses from the gateway for observability. It looks like the change accidentally rewrites/preserves the header rather than appending, so client hints get clobbered. rolling a revert now.

dan_oncall: if you revert, can we get quick repro steps to validate? customer can repro within seconds.

maria_support: customer can run this to repro quickly: 
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.example.com" -H "x-redwood-region: us-east" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embeddings
```
They also send a body and auth but header is the important part.

alyssa_infra: after revert, please include `-H "x-debug: route"` to force route debug logs in gateway; confirm `x-serving-region` matches `x-redwood-region`.

support-bot: ticket INC-2024-451 created, severity: high, impact: partial (some requests fail / high latency). Escalation: eng-runtime.

kevin_runtime: revert completed at 12:12 UTC. Canary shows errors drop from 32% -> 4% in the canary pool; full rollout in progress. Also observed an unrelated fallback edge: when a cluster health probe briefly fails, the fallback policy will pick any healthy region (aggressive) which can override pinned-region hints — that explains the intermittent cross-region hits. Filing a follow-up PR.

maria_support: customer still reports occasional cross-region hits after revert (low volume). Could fallback be the culprit? They depend on strict regional affinity for compliance.

kevin_runtime: yes — current fallback policy is `best_effort` which allows cross-region for availability. For pinned orgs we can set `strict_region_affinity=true` to disallow cross-region fallback unless explicitly allowed. I'll open the PR.

alyssa_infra: applying a runtime flag for org 3556 now: `strict_region_affinity=true`. I'll add a short monitoring rule to alert if any request returns `x-serving-region` != org-region for 5m.

infra-bot: config-change: runtime flag `strict_region_affinity=true` applied to org 3556 at 12:35 UTC.

maria_support: letting Acme know to re-test. Also confirming their billing looks normal but they flagged a billing spike due to retries/timeouts — they'll share logs if it persists.

kevin_runtime: created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/876 — changes: preserve client region hint in gateway filters, add unit + integration tests for header preservation, and tighten fallback logic for pinned orgs. Will follow up with postmortem.

dan_oncall: temporary mitigation steps documented: revert header rewrite (done), enable `strict_region_affinity` for affected orgs, and monitor. If customer still sees failures, collect `curl -v` output + gateway debug traces.

maria_support: customer confirmed: traffic seems stable after the revert + strict flag. They reported one leftover slow request that was cross-region during the 3m window before revert completed. They've reopened ticket with the logs; I've attached gateway debug traces.

kevin_runtime: thanks — we'll run the full rollout once CI passes for PR-876. Also adding an e2e to catch fallback override when `x-redwood-region` is present.

alyssa_infra: monitoring looks clean for 40m. I'll keep the strict flag for 24h and then coordinate rollback to default after we finish the rollout. :thumbsup:

maria_support: great, I'll update the customer and close the immediate escalation once they ack. Thanks everyone.

kevin_runtime: we'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. Assigning to eng-runtime for tracking.

maria_support: closing loop once Acme confirms.
